newsitem.title: FRANCE: France deplores fresh violence in Albania.
newsitem.headline: France deplores fresh violence in Albania.

text.p: France on Saturday deplored a fresh outbreak of violence in Albania on Saturday and urged all parties to begin talks aimed at a peaceful resolution of the crisis.
"This dialogue must begin as quickly as possible and without preconditions," the Foreign Ministry said.
"The new outbreaks of violence show that the financial and political crisis that has gripped this country for the past several weeks is far from over," a ministry statement said.
Protesters armed with pistols and rifles appeared to take control of the Albanian town of Vlore where some nine people were killed in an overnight gun battle.
In increasing signs of spreading rebellion, civilians on the road between the southern town of Vlore and Tirana threw up blockades and halted vehicles travelling between the two towns.

In Vlore, thousands of people armed with guns and rifles paraded through the town and gathered at the university where 42 students entered their 10th day on hunger strike in an anti-government protest sparked by the collapse of pyramid investment schemes in January.

France reiterated a European Union recommendation that the Albanian authorities quickly call in international experts to help them identify measures they could take to clean up Albania's financial sector.
